observation.command:
echo "=== port 80 open on host? ==="; (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ":80\b" | head
echo "=== Keycloak via 127.0.0.1:80 with Host header ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "keycloak root: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/
echo "=== Keycloak realms list ==="
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/ | head -c 200; echo
echo "=== api/backend health ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api /health: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/health
echo "=== meilisearch health ==="
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Host: meilisearch.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/health
